## Press Release


## BRAEMAR HOTELS & RESORTS DECLARES PREFERRED DIVIDENDS FOR THE FOURTH QUARTER OF 2026


Company Release - 10/16/2026


DALLAS, October 16, 2026 – Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) (“Braemar” or the“Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors (the "Board") declared a quarterly cashdividend for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026 for the Company's 5.5% Series BCumulative Convertible Preferred Stock equal to: $0.3438 per share, which will be paid onJanuary 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 30, 2026.


The Board declared a quarterly cash dividend for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026 for the Company's 8.25% Series D Cumulative Preferred Stock equal to: $0.5156 per share,which will be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 31, 2026.


The Board declared a monthly cash dividend for all CUSIPs of the Company's Series ERedeemable Preferred Stock, payable as follows: $0.15625 per share will be paid on November 16, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026; $0.15625 per share will be paid on December 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of November 30, 2026; and $0.15625 per sharewill be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 31, 2026.


The Board declared a monthly cash dividend for CUSIPs 10482B705 and 10482B887 of the Company's Series M Redeemable Preferred Stock payable as follows: $0.18125 per share will bepaid on November 16, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026; $0.18125 pershare will be paid on December 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of November 30, 2026;and $0.18125 per share will be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as ofDecember 31, 2026.


The Board declared a monthly cash dividend for CUSIPs 10482B796, 10482B861, 10482B770and 10482B846 of the Company’s Series M Redeemable Preferred Stock payable as follows:$0.17917 per share will be paid on November 16, 2026 to stockholders of record as of October30, 2026; $0.17917 per share will be paid on December 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as ofNovember 30, 2026; and $0.17917 per share will be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders ofrecord as of December 31, 2026.


The Board declared a monthly cash dividend for CUSIP 10482B820 of the Company's Series MRedeemable Preferred Stock payable as follows: $0.17708 per share will be paid on November16, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026; $0.17708 per share will be paid onDecember 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of November 30, 2026; and $0.17708 per sharewill be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 31, 2026.


As of September 30, 2026, there were 8,150,132 shares of the Company's Series E RedeemablePreferred Stock and 1,269,981 shares of the Company's Series M Redeemable Preferred Stockissued and outstanding, and there were an additional 2,448,062 shares of the Company's Series ERedeemable Preferred Stock and 91,129 shares of the Company's Series M RedeemablePreferred Stock issued and outstanding for which redemption requests have been received buthave not been fully processed.


**About Braemar Hotels & Resorts**


Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused onthe high-growth luxury hotel and resort sector. Its industry-leading portfolio features luxuryproperties across the United States and the U.S. territories in the Caribbean.
